excerpt: The Auger design features an array of 1660 water-Cherenkov particle detector stations spread over 3000 km² overlooked by 24 air fluorescence telescopes. In addition, three high elevation fluorescence telescopes overlook a 23.5 km², 61-detector infilled array with 750 m spacing.
publisher: The Pierre Auger Collaboration (Nucl. Instrum. Meth. A 798 (2015) 172)
title: The Pierre Auger Cosmic Ray Observatory
